entities.summary: Ahmed Shareef, , popularly known as Pagal Adilabadi, was an Urdu poet from Adilabad, India. He wrote mazahiya shayari or humorous poetry in his native dialect of Hyderabadi Urdu. His pen name, "Pagal", means "crazy" in Urdu.
